title: More enum issues
body:
Originally reported by: **Antony Lee (BitBucket: [anntzer](http://bitbucket.org/anntzer), GitHub: @anntzer?)**

---

Pylint'ing

```
#!python
from enum import Enum


class Enumeration(Enum):
    foo, bar = range(2)
```

leads to a traceback:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/pylint/lint.py", line 626, in get_ast
    return MANAGER.ast_from_file(filepath, modname, source=True)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/manager.py", line 106, in ast_from_file
    return AstroidBuilder(self).file_build(filepath, modname)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/builder.py", line 133, in file_build
    module = self._data_build(data, modname, path)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/builder.py", line 173, in _data_build
    module = rebuilder.visit_module(node, modname, package)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/rebuilder.py", line 151, in visit_module
    newnode.body = [self.visit(child, newnode) for child in node.body]
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/rebuilder.py", line 151, in <listcomp>
    newnode.body = [self.visit(child, newnode) for child in node.body]
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/rebuilder.py", line 164, in visit
    return self._transform(visit_method(node, parent))
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/manager.py", line 295, in transform
    ret = transform_func(node)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/brain/py2stdlib.py", line 303, in infer_enum_class
    real_value = parent.value
  File "/usr/lib/python3.4/site-packages/astroid/bases.py", line 51, in __getattr__
    return getattr(self._proxied, name)
AttributeError: 'Class' object has no attribute 'value'
************* Module test
F:  1, 0: <class 'AttributeError'>: 'Class' object has no attribute 'value' (astroid-error)

```
